(A) reserved a category of industries for the private sector, however, the sector
was kept under state control through a system of licenses. No new industry 4
was allowed unless a license was obtained from the government.
It was easier to obtain a license if the industrial unit was established in an
economically backward area. In addition, such units were given certain
benefits such as tax holidays and subsidised electricity. The purpose of this
policy was to promote regional equality.
